## What {product} does

{product} reads messages from one queue and writes them to another. You run it as a small service next to your applications.

::: note Before you start
You need access to both queues and a host that can reach them.
:::

## Check your install

::: command Print the installed version
windows: {binary}.exe version
linux: {binary} version
macos: {binary} version
:::

Write to {support_email} if the command does not print a version.
